description: Telecom customer data used to analyze and predict churn behavior

columns.State: US state where the customer is located
columns.Account length: Number of days the customer has been with the carrier
columns.International plan: Whether the customer has an international calling plan (true/false)
columns.Voice mail plan: Whether the customer has a voicemail plan (true/false)
columns.Number vmail messages: Number of voicemail messages the customer has
columns.Total day minutes: Total minutes spent on calls during the day
columns.Total day calls: Total number of calls made during the day
columns.Total day charge: Total charge in USD for daytime calls
columns.Total eve minutes: Total minutes spent on calls during the evening
columns.Total eve calls: Total number of calls made during the evening
columns.Total eve charge: Total charge in USD for evening calls
columns.Total night minutes: Total minutes spent on calls during the night
columns.Total night calls: Total number of calls made during the night
columns.Total night charge: Total charge in USD for night calls
columns.Total intl minutes: Total minutes spent on international calls
columns.Total intl calls: Total number of international calls made
columns.Total intl charge: Total charge in USD for international calls
columns.Customer service calls: Number of times the customer called customer service
columns.Churn: Whether the customer churned — true means churned, false means retained
